description: R61 P1-09: 高风险按钮 handler 元数据 sidecar + 门禁 baseline
note: handlers 段为每个已知高风险 handler 声明完整字段集(Rule B);baseline 段记录 Rule A/C 的现有违规(ratchet 下降)。Rule B 无 baseline,必须补全字段。

toggle_ban.mfa: required_for_ban (web session mfa_verified=True; ban_user 走审批,审批人需 MFA)
toggle_ban.state_transitions: pending -> approved -> executing -> executed (ban); pending -> executing -> executed (unban, 无审批)
toggle_ban.cancellation: supported via approval reject (pending -> rejected); executing 阶段不可取消
toggle_ban.localization_confirmation: admin.__init__.s42 (CSRF 失败) / admin.__init__.s43 (用户不存在) / 审批列表页重定向
toggle_ban.audit_schema: command_approvals(action_id, command_type=ban_user/unban_user, principal_id, request_hash, status, created_at); audit_log(action=ban_user/unban_user, actor=admin.id, target=user_id)

delete_file.rbac: PERM_CONTENT_TAKEDOWN (软删除复用 takedown 权限)
delete_file.two_person_approval: not required (软删除 requires_approval=False, 可立即执行)
delete_file.state_transitions: pending -> executing -> executed (无审批,直接执行)
delete_file.cancellation: not supported (软删除立即执行,无 pending 窗口)
delete_file.localization_confirmation: admin.__init__.s44 (CSRF 失败) / admin.__init__.s12 (文件不存在) / admin.__init__.s13 (权限不足)
delete_file.audit_schema: command_executions(action_id, command_type=delete_file, principal_id, request_hash, status, executed_at); audit_log(action=delete_file, actor=admin.id, target=file_code)

takedown_report.mfa: required (审批人需 MFA; submitter 继承 web session mfa_verified)
takedown_report.localization_confirmation: admin.__init__.s45 (CSRF 失败) / admin.__init__.s46 (举报不存在) / 审批列表页重定向
takedown_report.audit_schema: command_approvals(action_id, command_type=takedown_report, principal_id, request_hash, status); audit_log(action=takedown_report, actor=admin.id, target=target_type:target_id)

maintenance_action.mfa: required (审批人需 MFA; submitter 继承 web session mfa_verified)
maintenance_action.localization_confirmation: admin.__init__.s47 (CSRF 失败) / admin.__init__.s54 (未知 action) / 审批列表页重定向
maintenance_action.audit_schema: command_approvals(action_id, command_type=enable_maintenance/disable_maintenance, principal_id, request_hash, status); audit_log(action=maintenance, actor=admin.id, target=action)

_handle_restore_action.mfa: required (审批人需 MFA; submitter 为 AUTHORIZED_USER_ID bot 操作者)
_handle_restore_action.cancellation: supported via approval reject (pending -> rejected); restore:cancel 按钮取消确认
_handle_restore_action.localization_confirmation: bot.admin_bot.callback.s7 (未授权) / bot.admin_bot.callback.s8 (取消) / bot.admin_bot.callback.s12 (审批中)
_handle_restore_action.audit_schema: command_approvals(action_id, command_type=restore_backup, principal_id=user.id, request_hash, status); audit_log(action=restore_backup, actor=user.id, target=backup_id)

_handle_delete_file_action.rbac: PERM_CONTENT_TAKEDOWN (软删除复用 takedown 权限)
_handle_delete_file_action.state_transitions: pending -> executing -> executed (无审批,二次确认后立即执行)
_handle_delete_file_action.cancellation: supported via delfile_cancel| button (二次确认阶段取消)
_handle_delete_file_action.localization_confirmation: bot.admin_bot.callback.s15 (未授权) / bot.admin_bot.callback.s16 (取消) / bot.admin_bot.callback.s17 (格式错误)
_handle_delete_file_action.audit_schema: command_executions(action_id, command_type=delete_file, principal_id=user.id, request_hash, status); audit_log(action=delete_file, actor=user.id, target=file_code)

_handle_report_action.rbac: AUTHORIZED_USER_ID (admin bot 操作者, hardcoded 单管理员); R62 P0-04 后所有破坏性子动作走 CommandBus(make_ban_user_command / make_detach_file_command / make_block_user_for_file_command)
_handle_report_action.mfa: not required (bot 会话无 MFA;依赖 AUTHORIZED_USER_ID + 签名 token + CommandBus 审批门禁)
_handle_report_action.two_person_approval: ban 子动作 required (make_ban_user_command requires_approval=True, APPROVAL_ACTION_BAN); detach/block 子动作 not required (立即执行)
_handle_report_action.state_transitions: ban: pending -> approved -> executing -> executed; detach/block: pending -> executing -> executed (无审批,立即执行)
_handle_report_action.cancellation: supported via report:ignore (低风险不签名); ban 通过 approval reject (pending -> rejected)
_handle_report_action.localization_confirmation: bot.admin_bot.callback.s6 (未授权) / bot.admin_bot.callback.s20 (忽略) / 签名失败提示文案 (handle 短 ID 模式)
_handle_report_action.audit_schema: command_executions(action_id, command_type=ban_user/detach_file/block_user_for_file, principal_id=user.id, request_hash, status); audit_log(action=ban_user/takedown, actor=user.id, target=user_id/file_code); callback_nonces 表记录 nonce 原子消费(button_tokens 表记录 handle_id -> token 映射)

baseline.description: R62 P0-04: 按钮 handler 门禁 baseline 已清零(Rule A/C ratchet 全部下降到 0;Rule B 元数据已补全)
baseline.note: R62 P0-04 已修复全部 4 条 baseline 违规(report/restore/delete_file 走签名 token + handle 短 ID 模式 + CommandBus)。baseline.violation_count = 0,violations 列表为空。后续若引入新违规需走 --generate-baseline 重新建立 ratchet。
